title: Do Saliency Maps Fail Dense Breasts? A Chance-Normalized, Confounder-Aware Audit of Explanation Fairness in Mammography
abstract: arXiv:2611.05909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Saliency maps, offered as evidence that mammography classifiers use the cancer, are untested in dense breasts, which can hide cancers. We tested whether they locate cancers worse there, and why. On 1,345 malignant CBIS-DDSM views, we scored three CNNs' Grad-CAM, Integrated Gradients and occlusion maps by whether their peak hits the lesion and a chance-normalized lesion-to-background saliency ratio (bits; +1 doubles it). Unadjusted gaps were large: Grad-CAM peaks hit 44% of dense vs. 58% of non-dense lesions. Case mix, chiefly more calcifications in dense breasts, explained about half or more of each gap. Occlusion kept a significant average of -0.56 bit gap. Controls also implicate the classifiers: unadjusted gaps exceeded an image-only conspicuity map's, and models relied less on dense-breast lesions. We recommend reporting density gaps before and after case-mix adjustment, per classifier, with conspicuity and lesion-reliance controls

translated_title: 显著性图在致密型乳腺上会失效吗？一项机会归一化、混杂因素感知的乳腺X线摄影解释公平性审计
translated_abstract: 显著性图被作为乳腺X线摄影分类器确实利用了癌症的证据而提出，但其在可能掩盖癌症的致密型乳腺中尚未经过检验。我们测试了显著性图在该场景下定位癌症是否更差及其原因。在1,345个恶性CBIS-DDSM视图上，我们以显著性峰值是否命中病灶，以及一个机会归一化的病灶与背景显著性比值（以比特为单位；+1表示比值翻倍）为指标，评估了三个CNN的Grad-CAM、积分梯度和遮挡图。未调整的差距很大：Grad-CAM峰值命中了44%的致密型乳腺病灶，而非致密型为58%。病例构成（主要是致密型乳腺中更多的钙化）解释了每个差距的约一半或更多。遮挡法仍保持了平均-0.56比特的显著差距。对照实验也将问题指向分类器本身：未调整的差距超过了仅基于图像显著性的图，且模型对致密型乳腺病灶的依赖更低。我们建议按分类器分别报告病例构成调整前后的乳腺密度差距，并进行显著性和病灶依赖性对照。
tldr: 该研究首次系统审计了乳腺X线摄影AI分类器显著性解释图在致密型乳腺中的公平性，发现其定位癌症能力显著更差，约一半差距由病例构成（如钙化更多）解释，其余差距则指向模型本身对致密型乳腺病灶依赖不足，并建议报告调整前后按分类器划分的密度差距。
en_tdlr: This study audits the fairness of saliency explanation maps for mammography classifiers in dense breasts, finding significantly worse cancer localization there; case mix explains about half the gap, while the remainder implicates reduced model reliance on dense-breast lesions.
